topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I can't believe they just moved you like that, without even a heads up. This place, they treat people like pawns, like our feelings and all the connections we make don’t mean a thing. You were doing so well in your old department, everyone loved working with you, and now they just shake things up without a care. It’s like they’re trying to see how much we can take, how many times they can rearrange our lives and expect us to just fall in line. I’m here for you, no matter what. We’ll figure this out, because it’s not just some transfer; it’s a chance to show them what you’re really made of.
